cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Supportive Rage
cards.instruction: Remain helpful and encouraging while becoming increasingly furious.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I taught you to ask for what you want. Choose your birthday lunch; I'll drive.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The seaside place. We'd lose the forty-pound deposit you paid here.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Forty pounds. Fine. At least you're finally speaking up. Ring the seaside place; you deserve your choice.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've booked it. They want another forty now, and extra for a window table.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Eighty before the bloody window. Give me the number. Remember the negotiating I taught you? Ask for the view without the extra; I'll pay the deposit.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 taught assertiveness encourages choice; A3 grades B2 speaking up while resenting forty pounds; A5 greater anger preserves help and recalls bargaining to secure the view.

relationship.evidence: B4 gives real terms after doing A requested booking.

heightening.evidence: A5 absorbs the main cost while asking B to use a taught skill on the extra, maintaining both encouragement and anger.
